display_long_description:
Exploring Virtual Reality is now as easy as never before. The VRdirect app works like a browser for VR experiences: get direct access to your favourite experiences and create your own personalised VR app!

• Open VR experiences with the VRdirect app by entering a keyword or project code (Demos: “xxxxxx” or "yyyyyy").

• Once you have downloaded the VR experience, you can watch it over and over again, even when you are offline. You never need to enter the code again.

• Create your personal library of VR projects by downloading several VR experiences.

• Easily share your VR experiences with friends, colleagues and customers using the project code.

• And of course, the VRdirect app is free!

The VRdirect platform is the easiest way to create and distribute stunning VR experiences – no programming skills needed! For more information about the VRdirect platform, visit www.vrdirect.com
